body:
Thanks for the thorough review â€” all fair. Pushed a fixup round (`a738869`, branch rebased onto `c8fb599`). Point by point:

**Rebase fallout**
- `Makefile:6` â€” `dm3q-S918WVLS6CYB3` added to the filter. Also fixed the guard string: it said `FZG1`, now `dm3q`.
- KSU base decision: taking the v3.3.0 / 32601 path, no waiver needed. And it came out better than expected: the delta is **zero**. The `ucount_type` hunks are upstream at `KernelSU-v3.3.0-samsung-kdp-rkp-defex.patch:213-214`, and the resolve-before-RKP-return is upstream at `:867-871` â€” so I deleted the dm3q patch file outright and rewrote the NOTES as a no-delta record with line cites (`kernelsu/patches/KernelSU-v3.3.0-dm3q-5.15.148.NOTES.md`). Appreciate the confirmation on the dm2q ordering bug, by the way.

**Must-fix**
- Root helper: swapped in the current 44,520 B target-independent build (blob `5a4d32c`, byte-identical to in-tree f946b, no stale alias). Feed size updated.
- Toolchain: NDK r30 (`30.0.15729638`) is downloading now; the r30 `app.so` + shell preload rebuilds (third artifact included) land in the next push. Noting for the record that the `release` truncate gate is the only thing that can't be met under r30 (133,160 > 104,128) â€” CI's `< 400000` gate is unaffected.
- Doc contradictions fixed: stale NOT-tested statuses now point at the validation section; final artifact numbers (`104128/cb14959b`, `4629456/d972cd67â€¦`, helper `ee0a9f14â€¦`); su-grant item closed (it was done, the remaining-work section was stale); `--ephemeral` attribution corrected to ksud-side. Evidence logs (`test-attempt2.log`, `dm3q-attempt3.log`) commit with the next push â€” phone-side copies, pulling them tonight.
- KSU version: feed `notes` now carries the 32525-manager pairing caveat explicitly, plus the pending v3.3.0 pair rebuild + mainline-manager re-check.

**Nits**
- Audit: procedure + inputs named (23 ELF symtab / 31 BTF / 1 composite; workspace-local script, inputs `vmlinux.nm` + `layouts.json`). Patch-headers nit is moot (patch deleted). Sibling refs repointed at history. P0 note gained the sboot remark. Row-0 claim restated (same-RVA, different probe base). `--ephemeral` credit fixed.
- Pile-up knob: restated rather than wired â€” `S918_MM_PILEUP_FUTEXES` documents intent but is unconsumed (chain selects `SLIDE_KSNITCH_APPENDED_FUTEXES`), runs are keyed by artifact hash, wiring deferred to the r30 rebuild + device re-validation since it changes exploit behaviour.
- CI + release matrices both gain `dm3q-S918WVLS6CYB3`.

**App path (not yet run â€” device is offline right now, tonight)**
- Agree on all three env concerns. Pin-gate: if it never opens on dm3q I'll report it as the app-side policy question, not silently work around it. Attempts budget (3Ã—600 vs profile 8Ã—8s) gets decided deliberately once I see attempt telemetry through the app path. Parent check: re-verify the guarded late-load with the adb-`sh` parent specifically. Manager pairing re-checked against the mainline manager, not 32525.
- Feed entry (`SM-S918W` / `5.15.148`, data-driven selection) stays as committed â€” over to you for the app-side entry per your note.

Outstanding after this push: r30 binaries, evidence logs, pair rebuild + re-verify, app-path runs. I'll update the PR as each lands rather than going quiet.
